name: Tyrant Rave (Combat)
body:
The bones of your prey will form your throne.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, August Tyrant Style, Tyrant Crush, BAB +6

Benefit(s): While you are using this style, your attacks against a creature who damaged you since the end of your last turn or prone creatures deal double the bonus damage from August Tyrant Style. If you apply the AC penalty from August Tyrant Style to a creature, it is instead a -2 penalty to AC if you were using Power Attack.

Special: This feat’s benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
